page.layout: One column of running text; marginal note in the right margin beside the lines "In eâ concedunt". Running head top centre, page number top right. Catchword at bottom right, gathering signature at bottom left.

main_text.p: testis jurati, modo is non sit in ministerio ipsius Oldermanni, qui reijci ut suspectus potest. Oldermannus & judices hi nihil potesta-tis, aut jurisdictionis sibi usurpent in agrarios praeter id, quod ad ipsorum cognitionem proprie pertinet: Idem Oldermanuus ad hoc tribunal suum neminem citet ex agro nisi per mandatum Camerae provincialis, id est, Praefidis & Hovetmannorum: agrarii & peregrini a sententia hujus tribunalis Hovetmannos cum praesidè, cives senatum urbanum appellent, & recognitionem petant: Huic sententiae in consessu Ordinum generalium pronunciatae, & nomine eorundem a summo scribâ a secretis subscriptae, addidêre judices iidem aliam quoque eodem die & loco. In eâ concedunt agrariis ad exsolven-dum aes alienum tributum agro toti imponereSententia tertia eorundem secundum jugera per octennium eo modo, quem ipsi sufficere arbitrabuntur, atque insuper ex bonis monasticis ex decreto Ordinum generalium aureorum xvi millia capere. Ut tamen aes hoc alienum prius liquidum fiat apud ipsos provincias Ordines, nec excedat summam lxiv millium aureorum, quam summam ipsi agrarii ante erant professi: utque
main_text.notes: Printed head "Deque Vrbe Groningâ" transcribed with ā for the tilde over the a. Italic/roman boundaries in the body are approximate from the scan. The margin note is read as "Sententia tertia eorundem" with its line-end hyphen resolved. The catchword "utque" is taken from the bottom right and may be partly obscured. Show-through from the reverse side is present at the right edge and was ignored.
